inj.note: Lock has been working through an elbow issue to his throwing arm since late October, which has limited his participation in the first two practices of Week 12 prep. He started in each of the Seahawks' two games prior to the Week 11 bye, but is expected to revert to backup duties provided Sam Darnold (quadriceps) is cleared to start against the 49ers on Sunday. If Lock isn't available to play against San Francisco, then Jalen Milroe (illness) would be in line to operate as Seattle's QB2 behind Darnold.

news.h: Why the Seahawks are turning back to quarterback Sam Darnold vs. the 49ers
news.d: Drew Lock has been 'fantastic' filling in for Darnold, who has struggled with injuries but is on track to face 9-1 San Francisco on Sunday.

news.h: Seahawks beat Raiders 21-13 as Drew Lock throws for 2 TDs and Seattle sacks Fernando Mendoza 6 times
news.d: — The lead-up to Sunday's Seattle-Las Vegas matchup was almost all about Fernando Mendoza, at last receiving his first start as the Raiders' quarterback.

news.h: Seahawks are hurting with injuries, but two players will return vs. Raiders
news.d: QB Drew Lock will start again for Darnold. And LB Uchenna Nwosu and WR Rashid Shaheed will return to the field in Las Vegas.
